artworks.title: Ducks at Rest on the Bank
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting a water scene. There are outlines of plants and a bird near the water. The horizon is not clearly defined. The technique uses soft, delicate lines and a monochromatic color palette of shades of gray.

artworks.title: Swans at Stagnant Water
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a swan and a duck floating on water. The drawing is rendered in a delicate and minimalistic style, with fine lines creating the outlines of a swan and a duck. The swan is the dominant figure, with its elegant, curved neck being a focal point. The duck is positioned slightly behind or above the swan. The surrounding water is suggested with subtle, sketchy lines. The drawing captures a serene and peaceful moment in nature.

artworks.title: Rest
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman lying on her side, with only the upper half of her body visible. She is resting her head on her hand against a cushioned armrest. The woman has delicate features, slightly closed eyes, long flowing hair, and is wearing a loose garment. A bracelet is visible on her wrist. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Walk in the Boulogne Wood
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two geese near a body of water. The scene captures two geese surrounded by a natural setting. The foreground features the two geese, depicted with distinctive outlines and soft detailing. The background shows a serene landscape with the delicate depiction of trees and water, suggested through subtle linework. The drawing utilizes light pencil or ink strokes, emphasizing an ethereal and tranquil atmosphere of this natural environment.

artworks.title: Horse before the Race
artworks.description: This is an image of a horse in a racing setting. The horse is draped with a cloth or blanket, being handled by an individual. To the left, another person is seated, wearing attire typical for horse racing. In the background, there is another person mounted on a horse, as well as a few figures standing among trees. The setting suggests a preparation area at a possible racetrack, emphasizing the anticipation and energy of equestrian sports. The scene is captured in detailed line work highlighting the horse's muscular form and the textures of the environment.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait (Camille Pissarro, par lui-meme)
artworks.description: Printed with black lines and dense hatching, a man with a long white beard is shown from the chest up in this square portrait etching. The man looks slightly off to our right with deep-set, dark eyes peering over half-moon glasses. His mouth is hidden under a busy mustache over his full beard. A few tufts of hair peek out from under his floppy, light-colored hat, and he wears a dark garment that nearly blends into the shadowy background. Graphite inscriptions under the image read “1st Etat No. 11” to the left and “C. Pissarro” to the right.

artworks.title: Le Gue (The Ford)
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of figures riding horses through a river, surrounded by towering rock formations. The sky above has swirling clouds with dynamic brushstrokes. The style is detailed with precise lines and texture. The color palette is monochrome with shades of black and white.

artworks.title: Centaur visant les Nues (Centaur aiming at the Clouds)
artworks.description: The image shows a centaur archer on a rocky outcrop. The centaur, a mythical creature with the upper body of a human and the lower body of a horse, stands on its hind legs. The centaur is aiming a bow and arrow skywards, with the bow extended tautly. The centaur's body is muscular, standing on a rocky outcrop with a sparse background. The drawing employs shades and lines to convey form and tension, with shadows adding depth.

artworks.title: Cavalier Galopant (Galloping Horseman)
artworks.description: The image depicts a small figure sitting on a path surrounded by shadows and vegetation. The horizon features rolling hills against a dramatic sky. The brushstroke technique is intricate, forming swirling lines for clouds and earth texture. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of black and white. The overall effect is moody, emphasizing the detailed rendering of clouds and landscape.

artworks.title: Vue du Plateau de Bellecroix
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with trees and vegetation, viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is placed above the center, showcasing a variety of plants in the foreground leading to a dense tree line in the distance. The etching consists of fine, detailed lines conveying texture and depth, with variations in density indicating foliage and ground differences. The monochrome color palette contrasts dark ink with a light background to highlight natural details. Cross-hatching in the background suggests a serene sky.

artworks.title: The Madonna
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 17.1 x 11.9 cm (6 3/4 x 4 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing gracefully. She is slightly turned with one arm crossing her chest and the other hand holding a small book at her side. Her facial expression is serene. She has long, wavy hair and wears a headpiece. The woman's clothing consists of flowing robes with detailed folds. There is an ornate lily plant in a vase near her feet. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Jane Avril
artworks.description: This print is a poster featuring a woman in a dynamic pose. The woman's body is curved, her hips facing the right, her torso turned towards us, and her head looking to the left, tilted slightly backward. Her arms are bent and raised on either side of her head. She has off-white skin, bright red lips, a small nose, and yellow hair. She is wearing a long black dress with a red band at the hem. A blue and yellow snake appears to be wrapping around her body, its head on her chest. She wears a large red headdress that appears to have large feathers coming off of it. The background of the print is beige, and text on it reads "JANE Avril" on the left, with "H. Stern, Paris" and "1899" on the right.

artworks.title: The Vision of Saint Bernard
artworks.description: The image features two main figures within an intricately detailed architectural framework. The figure on the left is seated on a throne-like chair, depicted from head to toe. This person has delicate facial features, long, flowing hair partially covered by a light veil, and a halo. They are dressed in long, layered garments, holding a standing infant with a halo in their lap. The child is partially nude, holding a round object. To the right of the woman, another figure, dressed in a long robe with a hood, is kneeling. This person is depicted in profile, with a halo and a staff. An open book with a detailed design lies in front of him. The backdrop includes a large archway with carvings, cherubs, and a landscape with trees, a path, buildings, and mountains under a clear sky.

artworks.title: Fleuron for the Title Pages
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a winged figure surrounded by clouds and small birds. The central figure appears to be an angel or mythological being with large wings, depicted in a dynamic pose as if in mid-flight. The figure is clothed in a draped garment that flows around the body. The surrounding area is detailed with swirling clouds and an array of small birds. The use of shading and fine linework gives depth and texture to the drawing.

artworks.title: Fleuron for the Title Pages
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a winged cherub in the sky surrounded by flowers and butterflies. The cherub is smiling and adorned with a garland on its head, holding a small object in its left hand and outstretching the other hand. It appears to be floating amongst clouds. The scene includes various floral elements and tiny butterflies, enhancing the angelic atmosphere. The artwork features intricate line work against a plain backdrop, highlighting the central figure.

artworks.title: Joconde: Le depart
artworks.description: The image depicts three individuals in an interior setting. Two men stand to the left, one holding a feathered hat, while the other has his hand on his chest. Both are dressed in period attire with doublets, short trousers, and stockings. The man holding the hat has shoulder-length curly hair, and the other wears a decorative hat with feathers. To the right, a woman is seated in an armchair, wearing an elegant gown with ruffles. She has an updo with curls and appears to be holding a ribbon or sash extended towards the standing man with the feathered hat. The room is ornately decorated with patterned walls and intricate moldings. In the background, an open doorway reveals a staircase and another figure on the steps. The floor is tiled, and there is a table with a fringed cloth in the foreground.

artworks.title: Joconde: Le depart
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in a formal interior setting. The central figure is a man standing and facing slightly to the right. He is wearing a doublet with a sash tied at the waist, breeches, a feathered hat, and curly hair. To his left stands another man holding a feathered hat, with curled hair. On the right, a woman is seated, leaning forward, holding the hand of the central figure, with adorned hair and a long gown with detailed sleeves. The room is richly decorated with elaborate wall patterns and a large patterned floor. In the background to the left, there is a staircase with a visible painting or sculpture at the top.

artworks.title: Joconde: Le lit
artworks.artist: Charles Louis Lingée after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in a bedroom. One person with curly hair is sitting on a bed and reaching out to another individual. The second person, with shaggy hair, is holding a sheet and leaning over the bed. The third person is lying down on the bed, covered by a blanket. The room has a large canopy over the bed, draped curtains, a framed oval picture or mirror on the wall, a jug on a piece of furniture, a patterned floor, and a footstool beside the bed.

artworks.title: Joconde: Le lit
artworks.artist: Charles Louis Lingée after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior bedchamber scene with draped bed and furniture. The image shows a moment of intimacy and tension within an opulently furnished bedroom. The focal point is the canopy bed with elaborate drapery. Two figures are interacting in the center of the scene, with one under the bed linens and another beside the bed holding the covers. The room contains additional details like a pitcher on a side table, and an ornate chair, giving an air of luxury and privacy. Soft shading techniques are used to highlight the fabrics and shadows.

artworks.title: Joconde: Le lit
artworks.artist: Charles Louis Lingée after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: This image depicts an interior scene featuring a bed with rich drapery. The drawing showcases an ornate bedroom setting with a large canopied bed surrounded by flowing curtains. The room is dimly lit, emphasizing the luxurious and private ambiance. Details like a pitcher on a table and a framed picture on the wall enhance the classic and intimate atmosphere. The artwork conveys a sense of elegance and intimacy through textures and spatial composition.

artworks.title: Joconde: Le pardon
artworks.description: The image shows two full-length, standing figures and one kneeling figure within an interior setting. The standing individuals are positioned side by side. They both have curly hair. The individual on the left is wearing a large feathered hat. The standing figures are wearing ornate clothing with ruffled collars and fitted trousers. The kneeling person is leaning slightly to one side, resting their head on their hand. They are dressed in a long, flowing gown with a headband adorned with flowers. Around them, there is a table with an inkwell and an open book. The background reveals a wall with a decorative mantelpiece, an elaborate chair with a sword propped against it, and heavy drapery hanging to the side. The setting suggests an opulent and classically furnished room with large, arched windows.

artworks.title: Joconde: Le pardon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical interior scene with elaborate architectural details and period costumes. The image depicts an ornate room featuring a high ceiling with decorative arches and a large window with an intricate diamond-pane design. A person is kneeling beside a table that is covered with papers and a writing quill. Adjacent to this figure, two elaborately dressed figures stand, adorned in period-style costumes, with one of them holding a plumed hat. Behind them, a richly adorned chair is visible and draped with cloth.

artworks.title: Le cocu battu et content
artworks.artist: Jean-Louis Delignon and Antoine-Jean Duclos after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate interior scene featuring two figures, a screen, and furniture. The drawing depicts an elegantly dressed figure standing near a decorative folding screen, while another figure is bent over near the front. The room is opulently decorated with detailed wallpaper, a candelabra on the wall, and a plush armchair with an elaborately carved frame. The intricate design features, such as the patterned floor and the draped curtains, add a rich layer of depth to the image.

artworks.title: Le cocu battu et content
artworks.artist: Jean-Louis Delignon and Antoine-Jean Duclos after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: The image shows three figures: two adults and one child, all displayed in full. The woman stands to the right with her hand on her hip, showing an expression of surprise or concern. She has curly hair styled up and wears an elaborate gown with ruffles and lace. The man in the foreground is bending over, possibly gathering fabrics. He wears a blouse with long sleeves and a sash at the waist, with his hair wrapped in a headscarf or turban. To the left, a small dog with long, fluffy fur is seated on a chair. In the background, there is an ornate room divider. Behind it, a child looks over with short, curly hair. The background includes decorative drapery and an elegant chandelier with lit candles, implying an opulent interior setting.
